description: Update site-wide SEO title, description, social preview, favicon references, or search visibility in the selected site's root layout. Does not rename the dashboard label. Starts an asynchronous internal-agent operation; poll get_agent_session. For corrections, call this same tool with its sessionId and unchanged target. Requires a provisioned site. Source edits may execute in its preview. The Replo agent uses its normal tools and connected integrations to implement and verify the requested changes. Use publish_site separately to make changes public.

instructions.description: Requested changes for this operation only. Include necessary references, not conversation history, credentials, or unrelated personal data.

sessionId.description: Omit to start this operation. To continue, supply the returned sessionId with the same operation and target; mismatches and legacy sessions are rejected.

name: update_site_metadata
title: Update site metadata
